messages:
kevin: heads up — onboarding sample app hit a weird combo of SDK vs REST drift when upgrading to sdk@0.13.x. failing in CI during model metadata fetch and embeddings. repo: github.com/redwood/sample-apps/llm-onboard

tara: what endpoint is failing? full stack?

kevin: failing call is `client.models.getMetadata('redwood-chat-2')` -> SDK throws 404. curl to `GET /v1/models/redwood-chat-2/meta` returns 200 locally.

ron: SDK should call `/v1/models/{id}/metadata` not `/meta`. maybe a path-change bug slipped through in the refactor.

maya: also noticed examples in the sample app pass `max_tokens_per_chunk` to embeddings but REST expects `tokens_per_chunk`. SDK is forwarding `max_tokens_per_chunk` verbatim so gateway ignores it and we get default chunking -> quality regression in tests.

kevin: so three parity issues: endpoint path mismatch for model metadata, param name drift for embeddings, and a related auth nuance: CI env uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but SDK 0.13 added support for `sessionToken` and when `apiKey` is present the SDK now omits Authorization: Bearer in favor of X-Session-Token in some codepaths. curl with Bearer still works.

tara: that explains flaky CI vs local curl. any retry policy differences? I saw extra retries causing delayed CI runs when gateway returned 429 with Retry-After header set.

ron: SDK retryer currently ignores Retry-After on POSTs by design (we flagged embeddings as non-idempotent), but we should honor Retry-After for 429/503 and backoff. Also consider honoring idempotency-key header if provided so retries are safer for embeddings.

maya: immediate fix for onboarding: switch sample to direct REST for model metadata call and map param names in the test harness. also update README to recommend REDWOOD_TOKEN for hosted quickstarts.

kevin: agreed. I'll push a quick CI patch now (`[quickfix] ci: use rest metadata call + env REDWOOD_TOKEN`).

devx-bot: created issue #5012 "SDK parity: models metadata path, embeddings param name, auth header behavior, honor Retry-After" assigned to @ron

ron: I'll take the SDK fixes: 1) correct models metadata path, 2) accept both `max_tokens_per_chunk` and `tokens_per_chunk` and normalize, 3) ensure hosted mode prefers Authorization: Bearer when token present, 4) make retryer honor Retry-After and accept idempotency-key for safe retries. planning a 0.13.1 patch later today.

tara: add unit tests and a small sandbox e2e in CI to catch this class of parity regressions. thanks everyone.
